en.hook: Iceberg metadata bloat causes query timeouts across lakehouses.
en.body:
Iceberg metadata bloat causes query timeouts across lakehouses. Learn manifest rewriting and snapshot purging to restore sub-second SQL performance.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.

pt.body:
